scoring_justification: T1 recompute from raw LAPW outputs is infeasible because the required intermediate (lapw_output.json) is not a scored artifact with a standardized schema. We therefore use a combination of result-level comparison for η and recomputation from the agent’s own η to verify Tc, plus structural checks (grid/monotonicity).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for η and representative Tc
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I and Fig. 6 / text
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from published paper: η_total = 14.588 eV/Å² at a=4.60 a.u.; Tc ≈ 10 K at ω=1250 K, μ*=0.11.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper’s own reported numbers, the direct target of the reproduction.

outputs.description: Computed total Hopfield parameter η for fcc boron at a=4.60 a.u. (307 GPa).
Superconducting critical temperature Tc as a function of RMS phonon frequency and Coulomb pseudopotential, covering ω=1200..1400 K and μ*=0.09..0.13.

output_contract.notes: The checker verifies the reported η_total against a hidden reference value and checks Tc at a specific (ω,μ*) point and overall monotonic trends.
